title: 2028 Democratic hopefuls avoid backing Bernie Sanders' AI pause
description: Only one of roughly 20 potential Democratic presidential candidates directly answered Bernie Sanders' call to pause AI development, and none endorsed it. The silence comes as 70% of voters now oppose data centers in their communities ahead of 2028.
